component.name: CachyUninstall
component.summary: Safe application uninstaller and leftover analyzer for Arch/CachyOS

description.p: CachyUninstall helps you remove applications with full transparency: it shows what will be uninstalled, which dependencies stay (and why), and which application data remains afterwards.

It uses the real package database (libalpm), an evidence-based leftover scanner that protects files owned by other packages, and all privileged operations go through a small polkit-authorized system service.
